profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Coinbase | Prev SWE Intern @ Coinbase, Intel, Prelim | UC Berkeley Cybersecurity | UC Santa Cruz Computer Science

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Deployed a directed-acyclic graph to populate a Snowflake table which unifies analytics and events data to streamline data analytics and error tracing.
• Optimized a derived table SQL query by filtering on indexed columns and removing extraneous data, resulting in a speedup of up to 99.44%, reducing execution time from 3 hours to 1 minute.
• Published new versions of existing backend and frontend services to forward necessary Bugsnag metadata to Kafka streams and update relevant databases.
• Exposed new API endpoints to allow internal users to query the unified table by utilizing gRPC and Go.
• Spearheaded the frontend development of a timeline view in React Typescript, displaying events and errors, and providing teams with visualizations of actions taken per session, user, and platform.
• Integrated ChatGPT with the timeline view to allow efficient end-to-end analysis and comprehension of user interactions.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · TypeScript · React.js · SQL · gRPC

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Reduced technical debt within data centers by 50% by developing and refining internal tools using Python and Linux resulting in automation of global reports
• Increased the efficiency of physical maintenance by 100% by implementing the backend for the Red-Light Alerts application, allowing remote access to individual machine consoles within the data centers
• Restored and maintained an average of 50 data center servers a day by using Linux and Intel’s internal API, yielding exponential decrease in physical touch tickets
positions.insights: Skills: Shell Scripting · Unix · Linux · Python (Programming Language) · Software Development · Agile Project Management

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Standardized client data organization by utilizing Microsoft Excel, resulting in an overall decrease in average time to complete customer applications
• Developed flexible and scalable bank account applications for new Fortune 500 Companies each week using React.js and Node.js
• Mapped digital applications to the respective PDF application using Adobe tools, allowing customers to obtain a physical copy of forms
